verdict.rationale: Formant documents event-driven automation in its own docs. Events can trigger commands on the device, such as running scripts or publishing ROS topics (formant-docs-53, formant-docs-65). Formant events can also trigger outbound webhooks (formant-docs-28). Marketing pages describe configurable alerts and automated incident response (formant-docs-64, formant-docs-18). Missing for 10: detailed docs on how rules and conditions are defined (thresholds, filters, chaining), any AI-native or programmatic rule-authoring path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
